items.title: 10.22 Photovoltaic cells (sooraj ki roshni se bijli banane wale cells) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.22, printed page 239.

blocks.text: Lafz ‘photovoltaic’ do hisson se bana hai: photo (roshni) aur volt (electrical potential). Jo cell roshni ki energy ko electrical energy mein badalta hai use photovoltaic cell (solar cell) kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Photovoltaic cell aur galvanic cell mein energy ke zariye ka kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Galvanic cell redox reaction ki chemical energy ko electrical energy mein badalta hai aur reactants khatam hone par ruk jata hai. Photovoltaic cell roshni ki energy ko seedha electrical energy mein badalta hai aur jab tak roshni pare kaam karta hai; is mein koi chemical kharch nahi hota.

items: Photovoltaic cell: roshni ki energy → electrical energy (photo = roshni, volt = potential).
